mapper.sql: workspace_uuid, session_uuid, sha256, media_type, size_bytes, bucket, object_key, state
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO brain_image_attachments (external_id, organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, session_uuid, sha256, media_type, size_bytes, bucket, object_key) SELECT concat('bimg_', replace(CAST(gen_random_uuid() AS text), '-', '')), #{params.OrganizationUUID}, #{params.WorkspaceUUID}, #{params.SessionUUID}, #{params.SHA256}, #{params.MediaType}, #{params.SizeBytes}, #{params.Bucket}, #{params.ObjectKey} WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sessions WHERE uuid = #{params.SessionUUID} AND workspace_uuid = #{params.WorkspaceUUID} AND organization_uuid = #{params.OrganizationUUID} AND deleted_at IS NULL) ON CONFLICT (workspace_uuid, session_uuid, sha256) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE brain_image_attachments SET state = 'attached', attached_at = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE workspace_uuid = #{workspaceUUID} AND session_uuid = #{sessionUUID} AND sha256 = #{digest} AND state = 'pending'

WITH candidate_ids AS ( (SELECT image.uuid FROM brain_image_attachments image WHERE image.state = 'pending' AND image.created_at < now() - interval '24 hours' ORDER BY image.created_at LIMIT #{limit}) UNION (SELECT image.uuid FROM sessions s JOIN brain_image_attachments image ON image.session_uuid = s.uuid AND image.workspace_uuid = s.workspace_uuid WHERE s.deleted_at IS NOT NULL AND image.state IN ('pending', 'attached') ORDER BY image.created_at LIMIT #{limit}) ), candidates AS ( SELECT image.uuid FROM brain_image_attachments image JOIN candidate_ids candidate ON candidate.uuid = image.uuid ORDER BY image.created_at LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE OF image SKIP LOCKED ) UPDATE brain_image_attachments image SET state = 'deleting', updated_at = now() FROM candidates WHERE image.uuid = candidates.uuid RETURNING image.workspace_uuid, image.session_uuid, image.sha256, image.media_type, image.size_bytes, image.bucket, image.object_key, image.state
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM brain_image_attachments image USING jobs job WHERE job.uuid = #{jobUUID} AND job.type = 'object_cleanup' AND job.payload->>'resource_type' = 'brain_image_attachment' AND image.workspace_uuid = job.workspace_uuid AND image.object_key = job.payload->>'key' AND image.state = 'deleting'
